notes.title: Conveyor Shape Edit Tool
notes.content:
Super pleased to announce the [b]Append Shape[/b] tool will be included in our shiny 1.0 release next February.

This tool allows rapid pre-configured shape placement of
[list]
[*] Left and right 90° bends
[*] Left and right U shaped bends
[*] Left and right, Up and Down 3D loop
[/list]
We've put together a short video showing each of the shape actions.

[previewyoutube=bVAR2Y1Q4fk;full][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: - Left and right U shaped bends
- Left and right, Up and Down 3D loop
